title: FastThings
description: A mod for making everything faster for you!
body:
# FastThings | Brand New Generation!
FastThings is an advanced client-side utility mod built to optimize your gameplay, clean up your visual space, and maximize inventory efficiency during intense PvP and server grinding.

### 🌟 Features

* **Shield Status Overlay & Tracker:** Dynamically tracks shield cooldowns (axe breaks) on surrounding players. Displays a live visual color overlay (Red when disabled, Green when active) directly on the shield model, letting you know exactly when your target is vulnerable.

* **Dedicated Inventory Hotkeys:** Integrated direct, crash-free keybindings for "Place All", "Take All", and "Drop All" operations. Instantly clear or dump container layouts with a single keypress.

* **Full Mouse Tweaks Integration:** Includes complete Mouse Tweaks functionality out of the box. Effortlessly drag to move multiple items, quickly distribute blocks with right-click dragging, and use your mouse scroll wheel to rapidly transfer items in and out of containers.
* **No Fire Overlay:** Completely removes the annoying burning fire animation from your screen. Keep your vision 100% clear and unobstructed even when you are on fire.

* **Vault Drop & Fast Deposit Integration:** Fully compatible with virtual server inventories (`/pv`, Vaults). Instantly drop, transfer, or deposit items into custom plugin-based GUI containers using the one-click Deposit (✓), Withdraw (X), and Drop (↓) buttons without encountering desync or lag issues.

* **FPS Boost & Render Optimizations:** Built-in performance enhancements (`FpsRenderThings`) designed to streamline rendering paths, eliminate micro-stutters, and give you a noticeable frame rate boost in crowded arenas.

* **No Respawn Animations:** Completely removes the screen fade-in and transition delay when respawning after a death. Instantly restores 100% clear vision and full movement control, allowing you to jump straight back into the action without a split-second disadvantage.

---

### 🚀 1.0 Release Notes

This is the stable, official **1.0 Release** of FastThings! All core features have been fully rewritten, stabilized, and tuned for maximum efficiency in competitive environments. Startup initialization bugs have been resolved, and the mod is fully optimized for continuous multiplayer use.

🐛 Found a glitch or want to request a feature? Your input shapes the mod! Please submit your reports directly on our support server so we can patch them immediately.
